item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers
item.content:encoded:
Salutations. Long time, first time. I plan to read and possibly vote and offer feedback. I've been away from this site for a while. When I came back, there was a Series 6! I thought to myself, "hey, you mostly stick to old, proven works, why not jump into new stuff?" So I did. Then I thought, "if you really like some of these articles, why not join so you can offer some feedback?" And now I'm writing this.

"When is the last time it rained?" I've never experienced a drought nor do I live in an area where droughts really happen. Nevertheless, when that thought pops into my mind I have to try and figure out the last time there was rainfall or I cannot sleep.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello! After years of being too lazy to join, I finally made an account. Believe it or not, I've actually been a fan of the SCP Wiki since elementary school, probably around fourth grade? I was introduced to it by my sister, who just really liked giving me nightmares. I was instantly hooked though; I have vivid memories of browsing random articles on the school laptops when I probably wasn't supposed to. I've been in love with horror and weird fiction since, and it's honestly a huge influence on who I am today.

Though I've been a fan for awhile now, I recently rediscovered how much I love this website. For the past few days I've been doing NOTHING but reading SCP articles, drawing fanart, writing fanfic, and resisting the urge to annoy my friends by rambling about it. Now I'm really interested in writing my own SCP, and though I'm super nervous, I'm having a ton of fun coming up with ideas.

I'm constantly amazed by the sheer amount of creativity and talent in this community, and I'm thrilled to eventually contribute to it myself. =)

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello everyone,
I've been interested in SCP related media for about a decade now, it has always seemed really interesting and fun to me. I love thinking of weird things, and coming up with newer, weirder things! I plan on making many new posts, and I look forward to contributing to this awesome community.

Something that keeps me up at night is thinking about how every moment of my life that's in the past seems to have gone by in an instant, but everything that hasn't happened feels like it's so far away. When I'm on my deathbed someday, will I look back at my life as being instantaneous?

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello hello The Grinning Man! Welcome to the Wiki! I'm Ralliston, a site author and a member of the Community Outreach Team - with this helpful little comment, I'll try to help you find your way around the site and link a bunch of useful places and links that will help you in your SCP journey. I would say that your interest in the Foundation through its weird ideas and pictures is not really all that surprising - here, it's all about the weird and supernatural, isn't it? An insane imagination is a pretty good thing here, since you know what they say - the weirder the better :P

Without further ado though, let's click the collapsible, shall we? :)

+ show block
– hide block

If you're going to try your hand at writing, try out our Sandbox. You can make yourself a page here to store your drafts, which are in-works articles. Using it, you can link the drafts to reviewers to get their opinions on them before posting. It really helps everyone out a lot.

For brainstorming concepts, try out the Ideas and Brainstorming forum. You can run your ideas by experienced members of the community if you need help refining and fleshing out your concept. It's a very helpful little place for when you want to start your writing journey, especially when you're not sure if the idea is all that great.

If you have a draft ready, make a thread in the Drafts and Critiques forum. Remember to check the stickied posts in the relevant thread for guidelines on how best to use each forum. You can also try the IRC chat for real-time feedback.

From site usage to writing tips, the Guide Hub contains a wealth of resources geared towards helping members produce successful articles. Within the Guides, you will find useful information written by experienced members of the site for the use of newer ones.

The more time you take to familiarize yourself with the SCP style, the drafting process, and the community, the greater your chances are for success! Remember - there is no rush to writing - take your time! The more time you spend on fleshing your ideas out, the more your chance of success becomes!

As far as reading is concerned, you might want to check out Top Rated New Pages, which will display the most popular recent articles. It's helpful to keep up with what's being received well by the community to implement into your very own writing. Alternatively, you might want to look at the User Curated Lists page, where members of the community list and rank their favorite articles in different genres and themes, showing which attempts at such are successful and what the community likes.

Best of luck with your future contributions to the site! I hope you enjoy your time here as much as we do! If you have any more questions, feel free to message me here on Wikidot or on the IRC chats!

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
How do you do. I'm Piecemaker and I am honored to at last find myself in the Foundation.

I've been reading through various documentation for years with many favorites to speak of, and have recently decided it might be time for me to write one of my own. I'm gathered numerous experiences over the years through games, books, movies and I've always had a thing for creepy or unsettling things, which is why I often recommend SCP to my colleagues and friends.

That being said, I wish for my first document to be on a humanoid SCP. I have a rather specific concept in mind that I've been going over in my head for weeks. Now, I know, it's not recommended to start with a humanoid. How do I know? Because I've read through every guide I could get my hands on, from "So you wanna write a humanoid" to "Things what do a thing", as well as going through some 50 crits in the Ideas critique forum to see common pitfalls. I am nevertheless terrified of falling into an X-man syndrome or another common mistake, as the concept is rather close to me. Either way, I intend to give it my very best effort. See you in the Crit Forum.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers
item.content:encoded:
Hi there!

My name is Atlas (they/them), though I'll respond to pretty much anything. I got into SCP pretty recently thanks to a friend who writes stuff around here. I've been browsing the wiki pretty much constantly for the past two or so weeks. I'm not really sure I'll do much here besides lurk, but that might change at some point in the future. Who knows?

I spend most of my time playing video games and acting as a father to my two rat sons and my dog daughter. My other interests include MGS, fighting games, and music history. I also still have a plethora of German trivia carved into my brain from the four years I spent in German classes during high school.

Every night, I'm kept awake by a plague of self-doubt and fear that I will never amount to anything or achieve any goal I may set for myself in life. What if every dream and aspiration I've ever had has been perfectly achievable and the only thing keeping me from succeeding is myself? What if I do achieve the goal I think I want, only to realize that I only pursued it because it was easy, and my real goal is so much higher? What if I die before I figure out what I truly want in life?

Anyway, I'm very excited to finally be here and maybe put my overactive anxiety brain to use!

item.content:encoded: Hello everyone. My name is Brittany. I am from Texas and I work as quality control in the production field (I make the cupcake trays for Walmart and the white tray that the chocolate Easter bunnies come in). I am a mother to a two year old and a six month old and married to my best friend. I actually stumbled across the SCP universe thanks to Markiplier and I have been on and off the site just learning about different SCPs over the years but have never made an account. I have different ideas for SCPs rattling around my brain that I would love to attempt to contribute. I try to write in my free time, my husband and I both are collating to make our own books but being a parent takes priority (I hope yall understand lol). As far as my hobbies and interests, I love to paint, game, and watch a variety pf YouTube channels. I take interest in things that improve my knowledge and creativity. I look forward to collabing to help with crosslinking with both the seasoned writers and fellow newbies! Apologies for my intro being a bit sporadic, my social anxieties also effect online socializing as well!
